Some authorities recommend 20 to 30 grams of ﬁ ber daily, with an upper limit of

6During weight loss, attention should be given to maintaining an adequate intake
of vitamins and minerals. Maintenance of the recommended calcium intake of
1000 to 1500 mg/day is especially important for women who may be at risk of
osteoporosis.
